list.title: Scheduled changes
list.description: Changes that run automatically at a point in time. They run exactly once, even with several replicas.

empty.title: Nothing scheduled
empty.description: Schedule a flag to turn on or off, or to change its default, at a time you choose. A staged rollout ramps a variant up in steps, for example 10 % tomorrow morning, then 25 %, 50 % and 100 % over the next days.

noMatch.title: No matching scheduled changes
noMatch.description: Try another environment or search term.

noUpcoming.title: Nothing upcoming
noUpcoming.description: Everything scheduled has run. Schedule the next change or check the past ones.

noPast.title: No past changes yet
noPast.description: Completed, failed and cancelled changes show up here.

validation.timeInFuture: Pick a time in the future
validation.afterPreviousStep: Must be after the previous step

cancel.title: Cancel this scheduled change?
cancel.body: The change to <0>{{flag}}</0> planned for {{time}} will not run.
cancel.planNote: Other steps of its staged rollout stay scheduled.

cancelPlan.title: Cancel the staged rollout?
cancelPlan.body_one: The {{count}} pending step of the rollout of <0>{{flag}}</0> will not run. Steps that already ran are kept, so the flag stays at its current percentage.
cancelPlan.body_other: The {{count}} pending steps of the rollout of <0>{{flag}}</0> will not run. Steps that already ran are kept, so the flag stays at its current percentage.

retry.title: Retry this change?
retry.body: This schedules the same change to <0>{{flag}}</0> in {{environment}} again, to run in about a minute.

dialog.title: Schedule a change
dialog.description: It runs once at the time you pick, even when several replicas are running.
dialog.productionBody: Nobody will be at the keyboard when it runs, so double-check the change and the time. You can cancel it up until then.
dialog.rampHelp: Each step turns the flag on and gives this variant the percentage; the other variants share the rest. People who already have it keep it as it grows.
dialog.rampNeedsVariants: A staged rollout needs a flag with two or more variants
dialog.rampChooseVariant: Choose the variant to ramp up
dialog.confirmBodySingle: This change of <0>{{flag}}</0> will change what everyone evaluating it in <1></1> gets, starting {{delta}}.
dialog.confirmBodyStaged_one: This {{count}}-step rollout of <0>{{flag}}</0> will change what everyone evaluating it in <1></1> gets, starting {{delta}}.
dialog.confirmBodyStaged_other: This {{count}}-step rollout of <0>{{flag}}</0> will change what everyone evaluating it in <1></1> gets, starting {{delta}}.
